scope: Host source reservation ceilings; coordinator adds generator, dispatch, serialization, review and lifecycle counters.

reconciliation.referenceRootAttempts: sum all R/Q/H main and control counters.rootAttempts; full attempt 127038
reconciliation.referenceBisectionSolves: sum actual bisectionSolves; identity attempts count as zero solves
reconciliation.referenceEligiblePairs: sum R/Q main eligiblePairs; scene-dependent, no search
reconciliation.referenceRotorVisits: sum R/Q main rotorVisits; controls separately charged
reconciliation.exposureChecks: post-GPU assessment repeats saved-only stimulus exposure check; separately charged from pre-GPU stimulusExposureChecks

notes: Field loop counters are aggregated once per completed receiver or explicit failure return; raw cumulative counters remain in exception partials.
A guard/cap exception can stop counter delivery; terminal partial counters remain evidence and do not authorize reconciliation repair or retry.
preparedAdmissionRowsReserved is an advance reservation; prepareStates counts attempted states and partial metadata records completedStates/currentReceiver.
buildControls includes pinned host f32 vi simulation only to define branch-boundary input literals; no receiver bisection or candidate Newton runs there.
Reference quality and saved record checks recompute scalar coefficients/polynomials, never bisection, fields or Newton iterations.
The two exposure scans are explicit saved-value checks, not additional geometry or profile evaluations.
No runtime feasibility or physical validation follows from these counts.
